주말껴서 2박 3일로 짧게 다녀왔는데 너무 재밌구 맛집이 참 많았어요 ㅠ ㅠ 편집하면서 꼬르르륵..🤤 조만간 또 다녀와야할 것 같아요ㅋㅋㅋ🤍 언니랑 돈키호테 쇼핑 언박싱 하는 것도 찍어뒀는데 영상이 너무 길어져서🥹 바로 다음 영상으로 준비해오겠숨니닷! 오늘도 좋은밤 보내세요🌙

en-US.title: Heart-pounding💭￼First Fukuoka fun ￼Travel story🇯🇵-! Packing tips, cost-effective ryokan recommend...
en-US.description:
Many of you recommended a trip to Fukuoka.. I finally went there🤍!!!
I went for a short 2 nights and 3 days over the weekend, but it was so much fun and there were so many delicious restaurants ㅠ ㅠ My mouth is watering while editing..🤤 I think I need to go there again soonㅋㅋㅋ🤍 I also filmed my sister and I unboxing Don Quijote, but the video got too long🥹 I'll prepare it in the next video! Have a good night today🌙

⏱️ Timeline
00:00 Packing our luggage for our trip to Japan!
03:03 DAY1 Departing Yufuin!

05:34 Arrived at ryokan, sprinkled with street food in Yufuin🍡
10:57 Duty free shop, Totoro random box, unboxing Japanese snacks
15:54 DAY2 Hakata restaurant, gacha drawing, Don Quijote shopping
26:21 Ate bread at the hotel and unboxed gacha
28:39 DAY3 Restaurant opening run, stationery shopping, life fruit acidity🍓
